about: Lane inventory for FastNN 3.0 CI. Every lane states what it proves and what it does NOT prove. tools/ci/lane_status.py renders this table into the workflow run summary and fails the run when a lane that applies today has no PASSED record. A lane with no record is rendered NOT VERIFIED; absence can never look like success.

lanes.name: cpu
lanes.title: CPU build + tests (no GPU)
proves: The crate builds with --no-default-features, formatting is clean, package versions agree, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` reports zero findings, and the library plus fn3 contract and smoke tests pass.
does_not_prove: No Vulkan device is touched: it proves nothing about the Vulkan backend, shaders, or a physical GPU.
The pytest half of this lane exercises the Python binding; it does not run the Rust fn3 end-to-end model test.

lanes.name: vulkan-build
lanes.title: Vulkan feature build + committed SPIR-V validation (no device)
proves: Every committed .spv validates with spirv-val, and the shader sources recompile byte-identically through spike/vk-bringup/scripts/compile-shaders.sh.
The crate compiles with --no-default-features --features vulkan, and `cargo clippy --all-targets --no-default-features --features vulkan -- -D warnings` reports zero findings.
does_not_prove: A build is not execution: no instance or device is created, no shader is dispatched, and no validation layer runs.
SPIR-V validation proves the artefact is well formed, not that a driver accepts it or that results are correct.

lanes.name: vulkan-software-smoke
lanes.title: CI-ONLY software Vulkan smoke (lavapipe, no GPU)
proves: With VK_ICD_FILENAMES pinned to lavapipe and validation enabled, the Vulkan smoke test can create an instance/device and dispatch the implemented operations without validation errors.
does_not_prove: CI-ONLY / SOFTWARE: lavapipe is a CPU implementation of Vulkan. It proves nothing about a physical GPU, its driver, its limits, or its performance.
This lane must never be cited as GPU evidence; only a tools/ci/run-gpu-lane.sh record satisfies the physical-GPU lane.

lanes.name: packaging
lanes.title: Wheel build, install and smoke outside the source tree
proves: Package versions agree across Cargo.toml, both Cargo lockfiles, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, fastnn/__init__.py and CHANGELOG.md.
A wheel builds from this tree and installs into a fresh virtual environment with only its declared dependencies.
The facade and native extension import from the virtual environment outside the checkout and report the expected version.
When the pinned tiny-GPT-2 ONNX model is present (required for release), the wheel prepares a .fnn3 and replays CPU FP32 prefill and cached decode in a separate process without the source ONNX.
does_not_prove: It does not prove quantized inference, the Rust test suites pass, GPU support, or manylinux compliance.
When the pinned model is absent the inference step is recorded not_run with its reason; the lane then proves import and packaging only, never numerical inference.

lanes.name: pinned-model
lanes.title: Pinned-model end-to-end run (offline, single revision)
proves: When tools/ci/model-pin.json is pinned, the E2E fixtures named by that single file are used offline, and the end-to-end test runs against exactly that revision.
does_not_prove: An unpinned or missing pin is NOT VERIFIED, never a pass: the lane names tools/ci/model-pin.json and FN3-03 (#49).
A passing run proves numerical agreement on the pinned fixtures only, not general model support.

lanes.name: gpu-physical
lanes.title: Physical-GPU evidence (local/protected machine only, never hosted CI)
proves: A tools/ci/run-gpu-lane.sh record exists and validates: it names a physical Vulkan device, its UUID, driver version, Vulkan API version, validation result, pass/fail and timings.
does_not_prove: Hosted CI never runs this lane and no hosted job may claim it; a missing record is NOT VERIFIED, never success.
A software/lavapipe record is rejected by tools/ci/verify_evidence.py and cannot satisfy this lane.
The record proves only the named device on the named driver; it is not evidence for another GPU, OS or driver.
